resources.string: SAVE THE MOMENT YOU JUST PLAYED
Run commands on your PC after connecting USB. This app only displays and copies them; it never runs commands or grants permissions.
Install Android SDK Platform-Tools on your PC. Enable Developer options → USB debugging on Android, connect a data cable and approve your own PC.
Run adb devices and check that your device shows device. Choose COPY ALL COMMANDS, read the Accessibility note and run each step on your PC.
Windows PowerShell: inside platform-tools, replace adb with .\\adb.exe. Reinstalling the app, resetting the device or changing ROMs may require granting permissions again.
RECORD_AUDIO permits game audio and microphone capture. Enable or disable the microphone and adjust volume in AUDIO.
POST_NOTIFICATIONS permits Replay notifications. Run this step only on Android 13 or later; skip it on older Android versions.
PROJECT_MEDIA allows capture without another prompt on supported ROMs. If Android still asks for screen capture permission, confirm it on the device.
SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW permits the CLIP button over other apps. Then enable Floating CLIP button in CONTROLS if you want to use it.
deviceidle whitelist exempts Android Replay from battery optimization. If your ROM still stops the app in the background, check its battery/background settings.
The list includes Replay ThorKeyTriggerService and Thor Wayfinder ForegroundAppService; accessibility_enabled 1 enables Accessibility. Choose the shortcuts you want in CONTROLS.

The enabled_accessibility_services command REPLACES the entire list with Replay + Thor Wayfinder. If other services are enabled, append their components separated by : in the same command before running it.
Return to the app and choose START REPLAY. BUFFERING with increasing RAM means it is ready. Choose SAVE RECENT CLIP or use an enabled shortcut to export MP4.
The two buttons on the right open Accessibility and overlay settings for you to check. This app never enables services or runs ADB itself.
